args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, so the two names refer to the same account.
- Moss's coverage digest still has a saved report titled "Covey — Late Arrivals", which uses the old name.
- Please update the saved report's label to Pellow Home Living so the digest stops showing the retired name.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia
